assertions.assertion: Response includes updating the .NET target framework as one of the first steps
assertions.rationale: Step 1 updates the target framework from netcoreapp3.1 to net8.0/net10.0 and explicitly says to do it first.

assertions.assertion: Response includes replacing IdentityServer4 NuGet packages with Duende equivalents
assertions.rationale: It lists replacing IdentityServer4.* packages with Duende.IdentityServer.* equivalents, including EntityFramework, AspNetIdentity, and IdentityModel.

assertions.assertion: Response includes updating namespaces from IdentityServer4 to Duende.IdentityServer
assertions.rationale: It includes updating namespaces IdentityServer4 -> Duende.IdentityServer across .cs and .cshtml files.

assertions.assertion: Response includes creating and applying EF Core database migrations for both ConfigurationDbContext and PersistedGrantDbContext
assertions.rationale: It provides dotnet ef migrations add and database update commands for both ConfigurationDbContext and PersistedGrantDbContext.

assertions.assertion: Response includes configuring a license key for Duende IdentityServer
assertions.rationale: It includes configuring options.LicenseKey from configuration/secret manager.

assertions.assertion: Response includes verifying the deployment (e.g., checking discovery document, testing token issuance)
assertions.rationale: The Verify section checks /.well-known/openid-configuration and tests token issuance/validation end-to-end.
